newsitem.title: USA: One weapons truck found, other still missing.
newsitem.headline: One weapons truck found, other still missing.

text.p: A missing truck carrying machineguns and mortars for the U.S. military was found late on Thursday but another transporting missiles had not been located, a Pentagon official said.
"In fact it was never lost," the official said of the vehicle loaded with a 2,800-pound cargo of 50-calibre machineguns and 81 mmm mortars that "disappeared" west of Austin, Texas.

He explained that the transponder fitted to the truck, allowing it to be tracked by satellite, had "become inoperative" for several hours without the driver's knowledge, automatically triggering the search.

The second truck, carrying four unarmed missiles and last seen on a highway about 80 miles south of Dallas according to Texas officials, belonged to a private contractor and was not being tracked by satellite, the spokesman said.
He said the missiles could not be armed or fired, describing them as "mock-ups" used in practice runs, adding that they posed no safety risk.
President Clinton told reporters at the White House that he had been briefed on the missing trucks and also confirmed that one had been found.
"I believe the other is carrying weapons that are inert and cannot cause any harm," he said.
